data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 5s
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: pulsegate-pods
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
        namespaces:
          names: [pulsegate]
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
        regex: gateway|risk-worker
        action: keep
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_container_port_number]
        regex: 8080|8081
        action: keep
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
        target_label: job
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
        target_label: pod

data.datasources.yml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: PulseGate
    uid: pulsegate-prometheus
    type: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: http://prometheus:9090
    isDefault: true
    editable: false
data.dashboards.yml:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
  - name: PulseGate
    folder: PulseGate
    type: file
    options:
      path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards
